question: Did any BASS-II or FLEX test reach the lunar habitat oxygen level (30% or more)?
claim: Yes: 24 of the 274 FLEX tests (PSI-69, phase droplet, fuel Heptane or Methanol) reached 30% O2 or more, while 0 of the 129 BASS-II tests (PSI-25, phase solid) did.
summary_student: The FLEX experiment burned single fuel droplets of Heptane and Methanol in microgravity, and 24 of its 274 tests used 30% oxygen or more, the oxygen level of a lunar habitat. The BASS-II experiment burned solid samples in 129 tests in microgravity, and 0 of them reached 30% oxygen; its highest level was 22.2%. So, of these two experiments, only the FLEX droplet tests reached the lunar habitat oxygen level.
summary_professional: Of the 403 tests in BASS-II (PSI-25) and FLEX (PSI-69), all in microgravity, 24 had a highest O2 value (o2_pct_max) at or above 30% O2, all of them in FLEX. FLEX (n = 274, phase droplet, fuel Heptane or Methanol) spanned 12.0 to 34.0 % O2, with 24 tests at or above 30% O2. BASS-II (n = 129, phase solid) spanned 13.6 to 22.2 % O2, with 0 tests at or above 30% O2. Pressure was not part of this calculation.

method.formula: For each investigation, the lowest and highest oxygen percentage over its tests that report oxygen, the number of those tests, and how many reached at least threshold_pct (o2_pct_max >= threshold_pct).

columns: O initial ambient composition; mole fraction

assumptions: A test counts as reaching the lunar habitat oxygen level when its highest oxygen value (o2_pct_max) is 30% O2 or more, the lunar_base oxygen minimum in _config/environments.md.
Oxygen mole fraction and volume fraction are treated as equal, as stated in the data catalog.
Each BASS-II and FLEX row in the tests table is counted as one test.
limitations: This covers only the 129 BASS-II tests (PSI-25) and the 274 FLEX tests (PSI-69); it says nothing about other PSI investigations, such as BASS or FLEX-2.

Pressure was not checked: the BASS-II table gives no pressure, and this calculation did not compare FLEX pressures with the lunar base pressure limit, so it does not show that any test matched the full lunar habitat atmosphere.
All of these tests ran in microgravity, so they do not show how the BASS-II solid samples or the FLEX Heptane and Methanol droplets burn at lunar gravity.
Reaching 30% O2 only means that oxygen level was tested; this finding does not report what the flames did at that level.
How the 24 FLEX tests at or above 30% O2 split between Heptane and Methanol was not computed here.
warnings: PSI has no partial-gravity combustion data. Lunar and Mars conclusions are bounded by microgravity and Earth-gravity results only.

chart.idea: Range bars of the O2 levels tested by the BASS-II and FLEX tests, from lowest to highest % O2, with a dashed line at the 30% O2 lunar habitat level and the count of tests at or above it.

visual_offer.footnote: Want a visual? I can draw a chart comparing the O2 ranges of the BASS-II and FLEX tests against the 30% O2 lunar habitat level.
